DvpfTvH63g_CwrsVYx6DmA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續惡化,今年截至10/4累計報告8萬4,369例住院病例,其中2,256例死亡,9月份單月死亡達148例,今年累計死亡數為2,000年以來第四高,病媒蚊(埃及斑蚊)已由主要城市蔓延至全國,專家預測10月份疫情將進一步升溫。當局呼籲⺠眾積極清除家戶積水孳生源,以緩解醫療系統同時面對登革熱及麻疹等多重疫情的壓力。
DvpfTvH63g_CwrsVYx6DmA.en: The dengue situation in Bangladesh continues to worsen. As of 4 October this year, 84,369 hospitalised cases and 2,256 deaths have been reported, with 148 deaths in September alone. The cumulative death toll this year is the fourth highest since 2000. The vector mosquito (Aedes aegypti) has spread from major cities to the whole country, and experts predict the outbreak will intensify further in October. Authorities urge the public to actively clear household standing water, which breeds mosquitoes, to ease the pressure on a health system already dealing with dengue and measles outbreaks.

lQu-5iNul8z5h5Up_56VCQ.zh: 孟加拉西北部朗布爾專區某衛生中心截至今年9/24,收治37例疑症狀患者。該疫情與屠宰病牛後,牛肉分送約100戶食用有關,且牛肉檢體已驗出陽性菌,部分病例曾參與屠宰或處理牛肉。當局已啟動疫情調查,並持續推動受影響地區疫苗接種,以降低傳播風險。 尚比亞疫情更新,東北部穆欽加省截至今年9/21累計報告21例確定病例,病情穩定,另有59頭野生動物死亡。當局已啟動大規模家畜疫苗接種,並呼籲⺠眾勿食用野生動物肉品,以降低人畜共通傳播風險。
lQu-5iNul8z5h5Up_56VCQ.en: As of 24 September this year, a health centre in Rangpur division in north-western Bangladesh had admitted 37 suspected cases. The outbreak is linked to the slaughter of sick cattle, after which the beef was distributed to about 100 households for consumption; beef samples tested positive for the bacterium, and some cases had taken part in slaughtering or handling the beef. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and continue to promote vaccination in affected areas to reduce the risk of transmission. Zambia update: Muchinga Province in the north-east has reported 21 confirmed cases as of 21 September this year; cases are stable, and 59 wild animals have died. Authorities have launched large-scale livestock vaccination and urge people not to eat wildlife meat, to reduce the risk of transmission between animals and humans.

hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

j4iuKXFIJjwREzU4OchdxQ.zh: 孟加拉疫情嚴峻,今年截至9/20累計報告6萬1,972例病例,其中184例死亡,9月新增2萬6,126例病例及87例死亡,創今年單月最高紀錄。該國已於9月初啟動為期3個月之全國防疫計畫,加強病媒蚊孳生源清除與衛教宣導。 美國佛羅里達州本土疫情持續擴大,今年迄今累計報告152例病例,疫情多集中於希爾斯波羅郡(Hillsborough County),其中9/18報告1例死亡病例,血清型以第2型(DENV-2)為多,當局已擴大病媒蚊噴藥與孳生源清除,提醒⺠眾落實個人防蚊措施,並加強對重症之監測。
j4iuKXFIJjwREzU4OchdxQ.en: Bangladesh's epidemic is severe. As of 20 September this year, 61,972 cases and 184 deaths have been reported cumulatively; 26,126 new cases and 87 deaths were recorded in September alone, the highest monthly figure this year. At the start of September, the country launched a three-month nationwide prevention programme, strengthening the removal of mosquito breeding sites and health education. In the United States, locally acquired dengue in Florida continues to expand: 152 cases have been reported so far this year, concentrated in Hillsborough County. One death was reported on 18 September. Serotype 2 (DENV-2) predominates. Authorities have expanded mosquito spraying and breeding-site removal, urged people to take personal mosquito-protection measures, and strengthened surveillance of severe cases.

yJt6amxeRZIX2j9dFz75DA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續,自今年3月中旬以來,截至9/14,累計報告逾17萬例病例,其中20,124例確定病例、100例死亡。以首都達卡(Dhaka)12,410例確定病例(佔61.6%)、63例死亡為多,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)2,711例確定病例。當局雖已啟動大規模疫苗接種,惟病例數仍持續上升。此外,該國同時面臨登革熱疫情,導致醫療體系嚴重負荷。
yJt6amxeRZIX2j9dFz75DA.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues. Since mid-March this year, more than 170,000 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 14 September, including 20,124 confirmed cases and 100 deaths. The capital, Dhaka, accounts for most of these, with 12,410 confirmed cases (61.6%) and 63 deaths, followed by Chattogram with 2,711 confirmed cases. Although authorities have launched large-scale vaccination, case numbers continue to rise. The country is also facing a dengue epidemic at the same time, placing a heavy burden on the health system.

Y4E-BQz4OUIQU10UFCSlrg.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續上升,今年截至9月初累計報告42,590例住院病例,其中117例死亡,疫情已擴散至全國64個行政區,9/6單日新增1,558例住院病例,達今年高峰,各地醫院病床不堪負荷。當局警告9月疫情將更為嚴峻,單月住院病例恐突破3萬例,評估疫情可能延燒至10月。同時該國現亦承受麻疹疫情壓力(今年累計近千名兒童死亡),醫療與公衛雙重壓力遽升。 美國佛羅里達州本土疫情持續升溫,今年截至8/29累計報告73 例本土確定病例,其中近一週新增32例,新增病例主要集中於坦帕灣(Tampa Bay area),以第2型血清型(DENV-2)為多。當局已啟動空中與地面聯合噴藥作業,進行成蚊撲滅與蚊子幼蟲防治,呼籲⺠眾落實個人防護與清除孳生源。
Y4E-BQz4OUIQU10UFCSlrg.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to rise: as of early September this year, 42,590 hospitalised cases and 117 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 64 districts nationwide, and on 6 September 1,558 hospitalised cases were added in a single day, the highest this year, with hospital beds across the country overloaded. Authorities warn that the epidemic will be more severe in September, with monthly hospitalisations possibly exceeding 30,000, and assess that it may continue into October. The country is also under pressure from a measles epidemic (nearly 1,000 children have died this year), placing a sharp dual burden on health and public health systems. In Florida, USA, locally acquired dengue continues to rise: as of 29 August this year, 73 locally acquired confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 32 of them in the past week. New cases are concentrated in the Tampa Bay area, mainly serotype 2 (DENV-2). Authorities have launched joint aerial and ground spraying to kill adult mosquitoes and control larvae, and urge people to take personal protective measures and remove breeding sources.

wjhpbjHU_XWySmMUf2wu6A.zh: 孟加拉持續發生大規模疫情,自今年3月中旬以來累計逾16.3萬例疑病例、1.9萬例確定病例,並導致至少991名幼童染疫死亡。當局已啟動大規模疫苗接種,惟病例數仍持續上升,近期每日仍新增約800至1,100例疑病例。
wjhpbjHU_XWySmMUf2wu6A.en: Bangladesh continues to experience a large-scale epidemic. Since mid-March this year, more than 163,000 suspected cases and 19,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and at least 991 young children have died from infection. Authorities have launched large-scale vaccination, but case numbers continue to rise; recently, about 800 to 1,100 new suspected cases are still being added each day.

ZkxTRUH9crFJXnTG3SWl2g.zh: 馬來西亞今年截至8/22累計報告5萬8,079例病例,其中55例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加56.2%,疫情主要集中於中部雪蘭莪州(Selangor),報告逾2.5萬例,吉隆坡等地疫情亦上升。當局表示天氣變化造成疫情攀升,已啟動早期病例偵測及病媒蚊防治等措施,另因自費價偏高且宣導不足,登革熱疫苗接種率處低點。 孟加拉疫情持續上升,今年截至8/22累計報告2萬8,090例住院病例,其中77例死亡,疫情高於去年同期,且8月疫情較7月增幅高。目前部分醫院專責病房已滿載,多數患者入院時已有血壓下降及休克等併發症,當局表示近期間歇性降雨有利於病媒蚊孳生,加上全國蚊媒防治措施未達預期,預期疫情將持續攀升至10月。
ZkxTRUH9crFJXnTG3SWl2g.en: Malaysia reported 58,079 cases cumulatively as of 22 August this year, including 55 deaths; cases are 56.2% higher than in the same period last year. The outbreak is concentrated in Selangor state in central Malaysia, which has reported more than 25,000 cases, and cases are also rising in Kuala Lumpur and other areas. Authorities say weather changes have driven the rise; early case detection and vector mosquito control measures have been launched. Uptake of dengue vaccination is at a low point because the out-of-pocket price is high and awareness is inadequate. Bangladesh's epidemic continues to rise: as of 22 August this year, 28,090 hospitalised cases have been reported cumulatively, including 77 deaths. The epidemic is higher than the same period last year, and the increase in August was larger than in July. Some hospital dedicated wards are now full, and most patients already had complications such as falling blood pressure and shock on admission. Authorities say recent intermittent rain favours mosquito breeding and that nationwide vector control measures have not met expectations; they expect the outbreak to keep rising into October.

B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續擴大,今年截至8/11,累計報告近14萬例病例其中17,385例確定病例及880例死亡(98例確定),所有行政區皆有病例,主要集中於首都達卡(Dhaka Division;60,866例、404例死亡),較為嚴重,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)及巴里薩爾(Barishal),當局持續擴大疫苗接種活動。 美洲區今年截至7月中旬,累積4,7459例確定病例,44例死亡,今年累積確定病例數相較去年同期5,123例增加8倍,且為自2004年以來確定病例數最多之一年,病例數以瓜地馬拉、墨西哥、美國及祕魯最為嚴峻,合計占該洲病例數95%,另以20-29 歲年齡組病例比例最高(31%)。 美國今年截至8/13累積報告2,566例(含16例境外移入),約19% 為5歲(含)以下兒童,67%為青少年,7%患者需住院治療。主要集中於南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例);賓州為目前疫情熱區,8/17當週新增60例確定病例,迄今累計307例。另93%病患為未接種疫苗或疫苗接種史不明。 瑞典今年截至8/17報告10例疑病例,可能與7/31至8/1辦理之音樂節相關,多數病例為18歲以下兒童;該國已啟動接觸者追蹤與跨國通報,並持續監測相關疫情。
B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to expand. As of 11 August this year, nearly 140,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17,385 confirmed cases and 880 deaths (98 of them confirmed). Cases have been reported in all administrative areas and are concentrated mainly in the capital, Dhaka Division (60,866 cases, 404 deaths), followed by Chattogram and Barishal; authorities continue to expand vaccination activities. In the Americas, as of mid-July this year, 47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Confirmed cases this year are 8 times the 5,123 in the same period last year, making this one of the years with the highest number of confirmed cases since 2004. Cases are most severe in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States and Peru, which together account for 95% of the region's cases; the 20–29 age group has the highest proportion (31%). In the United States, as of 13 August this year, 2,566 cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively; about 19% were children aged 5 and under, 67% were adolescents, and 7% of patients required hospitalisation. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Pennsylvania is currently the hotspot, with 60 confirmed cases added in the week of 17 August and 307 cumulatively to date. In addition, 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Sweden reported 10 suspected cases as of 17 August this year, possibly linked to a music festival held on 31 July–1 August; most were children under 18. The country has initiated contact tracing and cross-border notification and continues to monitor the related outbreak.

6Wr7CB2J61PMs4Ct4w2-Ug.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至7/16,累計報告2,260例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19歲以下(70%)族群,有146 例(6%)需住院治療,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(518例)、德州(182例)及維吉亞州(176)例;該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 孟加拉今年截至7/15,累計報告逾11萬例病例(1萬3,907例確定病例),累計達771例(95例確定)死亡,以首都達卡(8,912例確定病例、59例死亡)最為嚴峻,疫情呈地域性蔓延,全國8個行政區均有通報及死亡病例。儘管該國疫苗覆蓋率高達99%,惟疫情仍持續傳播,懷疑覆蓋率高為近期加強推動接種活動的結果,後續仍需結合常規免疫指標,監測流行學病學趨勢。 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情上升,今年截至6/28,累計報告9萬9,200例確定病例,高於去年同期3萬4,000例,主要集中於東部南基伍省(26,900例)和北基伍省(17,500例),兩省總病例數合計佔該國45%;由於該國面臨兒童營養不良、武裝衝突等因素,影響WHO常規疫苗接種計畫,導致該國疫情擴大。
6Wr7CB2J61PMs4Ct4w2-Ug.en: The outbreak in the United States continues to rise. As of 16 July this year, 2,260 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years; 146 (6%) required hospitalization, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (518), Texas (182) and Virginia (176). The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. In Bangladesh, as of 15 July this year, more than 110,000 cases have been reported cumulatively (13,907 confirmed cases), and cumulative deaths have reached 771 (95 confirmed). The capital, Dhaka, is the most severely affected (8,912 confirmed cases and 59 deaths), and the outbreak is spreading regionally, with cases and deaths reported in all 8 administrative divisions nationwide. Although the country's vaccination coverage is as high as 99%, transmission continues. It is suspected that the high coverage rate is the result of recently intensified vaccination campaigns, so routine immunization indicators need to be considered alongside monitoring of epidemiological trends. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), cases are rising. As of 28 June this year, 99,200 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 34,000 in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in South Kivu Province (26,900) and North Kivu Province (17,500), which together account for 45% of the national total. Because of factors including child malnutrition and armed conflict, which affect WHO's routine vaccination programme, the outbreak has expanded.

TbXnWKLSy3clwJ-s5nt2OQ.zh: 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,近1週(6/15-21)新增5,267例疑病例,今年截至6/27累計報告52,068例病例,病例主要分布於西部省的可倫坡及加姆珀哈區分別為10,839及10,113例,該國6月迄今已報告18,227例(占今年病例數的35%)。 孟加拉疫情更新,近1週新增約1千例病例,今年迄今累計報告5,800例病例,主要分布於巴里薩爾及吉大港區,該國6月截至6/28已報告2,603例(占今年病例數的45%)。
TbXnWKLSy3clwJ-s5nt2OQ.en: Sri Lanka's outbreak is rising. In the past week (15–21 June), 5,267 suspected cases were added, and this year as of 27 June, 52,068 cases have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in the Western Province, with 10,839 in Colombo and 10,113 in Gampaha District. Sri Lanka has reported 18,227 cases so far in June, 35% of this year's total. Bangladesh's outbreak update: about 1,000 new cases were added in the past week, and 5,800 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, mainly in the Barisal and Chattogram divisions. Bangladesh reported 2,603 cases in June through 28 June, 45% of this year's total.

m3B-QSkjq4z1pBzYacu06w.zh: 美國上週新增 31 例確定病例,今年累計2,104例(含11例境外移入),趨近114年全年確定病例數(2,288例) 。高達93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,其中21%為5歲以下兒童,51%為5至19 歲青少年,另約 6%的患者需住院治療 。以東南部南卡羅來納州累計670例為多,其次為西部猶他州(498例)。此外,東部維吉亞州近期疫情升溫,上週新增19例確定病例,累計達129例,多與5月白金漢郡(Buckingham)群聚疫情相關。 孟加拉自今年3月中旬以來疫情持續擴大,全國已累計通報9萬2,790例疑病例及逾1萬例確定病例,此為該國史上規模最大疫情,近期新增7名兒童疑染疫死亡。達卡地區累計病例最多,疑病例42,766例,確診病例7,501例;其他累計疑病例較多之地區包括吉大港(15,700例)、巴里薩爾(9,063例)、拉傑沙希(7,639 例)和庫爾納(6,648例)。
m3B-QSkjq4z1pBzYacu06w.en: The United States reported 31 new confirmed cases last week, bringing its total for this year to 2,104 (including 11 imported cases), approaching the 2,288 confirmed cases reported for the whole of 2025. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. By age, 21% were children under 5 years and 51% were adolescents aged 5 to 19 years, and about 6% required hospitalization. South Carolina has the highest cumulative total, with 670 cases, followed by Utah (498). In addition, cases in eastern Virginia have risen recently, with 19 new confirmed cases last week, bringing the cumulative total to 129; most are linked to a May outbreak in Buckingham County. In Bangladesh, the outbreak has continued to expand since mid-March this year. Nationwide, 92,790 suspected cases and more than 10,000 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, making this the largest outbreak in the country's history. Recently, 7 children with suspected infection have died. Dhaka has the most cumulative cases, with 42,766 suspected and 7,501 confirmed cases. Other areas with high cumulative suspected cases include Chattogram (15,700), Barisal (9,063), Rajshahi (7,639) and Khulna (6,648).

f48vuX3YKe8UqBCyr2d1tw.zh: 馬來西亞疫情上升,今年截至6/13累計報告33,367例病例,較去年同期27,640例上升27%,病例數以雪蘭莪州15,422例最多。該國今年已報告23例死亡,較去年同期17例死亡上升35%,目前主要流行型別為DENV-3。 孟加拉疫情更新,最近24小時內新增60例病例,今年截至6/20 累計4,680例病例及7例死亡,病例數以巴里薩爾市1,243例為多,該國近期疫情遽升,自6月迄今病例數1,483例,為5月病例數(714例)的2倍,且以男性為多(62.9%)。
f48vuX3YKe8UqBCyr2d1tw.en: Malaysia's outbreak is rising. As of 13 June this year, 33,367 cases have been reported cumulatively, 27% higher than the 27,640 cases in the same period last year. Selangor State has the most cases, with 15,422. Malaysia has reported 23 deaths this year, 35% higher than the 17 deaths in the same period last year. The main circulating serotype is DENV-3. Bangladesh's outbreak update: in the past 24 hours, 60 new cases were added, and as of 20 June this year, 4,680 cases and 7 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Barisal City has the most cases, with 1,243. The outbreak in Bangladesh has recently surged: cases since June total 1,483, twice the 714 cases reported in May, and male cases predominate (62.9%).

x8c7K9KuaiSaixHxn5CWHw.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,過去24小時內新增972例病例,自今年3月中旬爆發疫情迄今累計報告86,923例疑病例(10,387例為確定病例),死亡656例(其中93例確定病例死亡),致死率為0.9%,疫情以首都達卡地區最為嚴峻。 美國疫情更新,今年迄今累計2,073例病例,6%病患住院治療,近期維吉亞州白金漢郡病例數明顯上升,該州今年迄6/11 已累計110例病例。另該國去年全年累計2,288例病例。 瓜地馬拉自今年1/9迄6/12累計報告16,840例病例(6,903例為確定病例),其中有22例死亡,死亡病例以7歲以下兒童為主,1歲以下兒童死亡率高於一般族群,隨著當局大規模疫苗接種措施,疫情已呈下降趨勢,惟隨著實驗室診斷確診為非必要項目,實際疫情仍可能受低估。
x8c7K9KuaiSaixHxn5CWHw.en: Bangladesh outbreak update: in the past 24 hours, 972 new cases were added. Since the outbreak began in mid-March this year, 86,923 suspected cases (including 10,387 confirmed cases) have been reported cumulatively, with 656 deaths (93 of them confirmed cases), a case fatality ratio of 0.9%. The outbreak is most severe in the capital, Dhaka. United States outbreak update: 2,073 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, and 6% of patients were hospitalized. Cases in Buckingham County, Virginia, have risen markedly recently, and the state has reported 110 cases cumulatively this year as of 11 June. The country reported 2,288 cases for the whole of last year. Guatemala has reported 16,840 cases cumulatively from 9 January this year to 12 June (6,903 confirmed), including 22 deaths. Deaths are mainly among children under 7 years, and the mortality rate among infants under 1 year is higher than in the general population. With large-scale vaccination by authorities, the outbreak has shown a downward trend; however, as laboratory confirmation is no longer a required step for every case, the actual outbreak may still be underestimated.

7y0LnGrNoiw1KQYpL1RJYA.zh: 孟加拉今年自3/15截至6/9累計報告8萬0,104例病例(其中9,779 例為確定病例),死亡628例(其中92例確定病例死亡),已有61,278例康復,疫情以首都達卡地區最為嚴峻,已報告3萬7,387例疑病例及6,794例確定病例。 美國今年截至6/4累計報告2,030例確定病例,其中127例住院,疫情分布40個州,病患以5-19歲年齡層占大宗(51%),有92%病例未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。
7y0LnGrNoiw1KQYpL1RJYA.en: Bangladesh has reported 80,104 cumulative cases this year from 15 March to 9 June, of which 9,779 were confirmed, with 628 deaths (92 among confirmed cases) and 61,278 recovered. The outbreak is most severe in the capital Dhaka region, where 37,387 suspected cases and 6,794 confirmed cases have been reported. The United States has reported 2,030 confirmed cases this year as of 4 June, of which 127 were hospitalised. Cases have been reported in 40 states; those aged 5–19 years make up the majority (51%), and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status.

rHOXeEPfBZ9tyZ9gdbofAw.zh: 日本今年迄今累計511例病例,已逾去年全年病例數(265例),近4週增幅趨緩,感染者多為20至29歲族群,以東京都、神奈川縣及埼玉縣為多,境外移入感染國以印為多,多數病例接種史不明、未接種或接種1劑疫苗。 孟加拉疫情嚴峻,自今年3月爆發疫情迄今累計報告70,936例病例(9,049例確診),585例相關死亡病例(90例確診),達卡地區最為嚴峻(6,306例確診)。
rHOXeEPfBZ9tyZ9gdbofAw.en: Japan has reported 511 cumulative cases so far this year, already exceeding the full-year total for last year (265 cases). The increase has slowed over the past four weeks. Most infected people are aged 20–29, with the most cases in Tokyo Metropolis, Kanagawa Prefecture and Saitama Prefecture. Among imported cases, most were acquired in India. Most cases had an unknown vaccination history, were unvaccinated, or had received one dose of vaccine. Bangladesh's outbreak is severe: since it began in March this year, 70,936 cases (9,049 confirmed) and 585 related deaths (90 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively. The Dhaka region is the most severely affected, with 6,306 confirmed cases.

pmNbL9pmC4DN-aztBfVPrA.zh: 孟加拉3/15-5/23累計報告512例死亡病例,為數十年來最嚴峻疫情,該國自2024年疫苗接種計畫停滯後,導致大批兒童缺乏免疫力,當局因應疫情,已進行1,800萬兒童之疫苗接種。
pmNbL9pmC4DN-aztBfVPrA.en: From 15 March to 23 May, Bangladesh reported 512 measles deaths cumulatively, making this the most severe outbreak in decades. Since the vaccination programme stalled in 2024, large numbers of children have lacked immunity. In response, authorities have vaccinated 18 million children.

9G0LeTYB1366Vnz1FmGS-g.zh: 孟加拉爆發20年來最嚴重疫情,今年截至5/11止,全國累計報告逾5萬例疑病例(350例死亡)及6,937例確診病例(65例死亡),累計近3.6萬例住院。疫情遍及全國,以達卡專區最為嚴峻。疫情爆發主因係常規疫苗覆蓋率長期低於95%,且兒童營養不良加劇重症風險。當局自4月起推動全國緊急疫苗接種,惟每日仍有逾千例新增報告,社區傳播風險持續。 加拿大今年截至4月底已累計逾900例確診,以中部曼托巴省為多,該省報告622例(549例確診;佔全國61%),其中46例住院(含4例重症),半數為10歲以下兒童,暫無死亡病例。該國過往每年平均僅報告約91例,惟2025年病例數激增至5,425例,致於當年底被撤銷「消除麻疹國家認證」。目前流行株與去年同為D8基因型,顯示社區傳播持續,疫情風險仍高。
9G0LeTYB1366Vnz1FmGS-g.en: Bangladesh is experiencing its most severe measles outbreak in 20 years. As of 11 May this year, more than 50,000 suspected cases (350 deaths) and 6,937 confirmed cases (65 deaths) had been reported nationwide, with nearly 36,000 hospitalisations cumulatively. The outbreak has spread across the country and is most severe in the Dhaka division. The outbreak was driven mainly by routine vaccination coverage remaining below 95% for a long time, and child malnutrition has increased the risk of severe disease. Since April, authorities have launched nationwide emergency vaccination, but more than 1,000 new cases are still reported each day, and community transmission risk continues. Canada reported more than 900 confirmed cases this year as of the end of April, mainly in the central province of Manitoba. Manitoba reported 622 cases (549 confirmed; 61% of the national total), of which 46 were hospitalised, including four severe cases. Half are children aged 10 and under, and there have been no deaths so far. Canada previously reported an average of about 91 cases a year, but cases surged to 5,425 in 2025, and the country lost its measles elimination status at the end of that year. The circulating strain is genotype D8, the same as last year, indicating continued community transmission and ongoing high risk.

lvCTwlbbJhjn9_fari351Q.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:孟加拉新增 1 例 H5N1 病例、中國新增 1 例 H5N6 病例。全球今年累計報告 20 例,分別為 6 例 H5N1、1 例 H5N6、12 例 H9N2 及 1 例 H10N3,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計 56 國家/地區報告 3,367 起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共 12 國於 2026/4/30-5/8 期間報告 43 起 H5N1 疫情,波蘭13 起、美國 7 起、英國 6 起、丹麥/挪威各 3 起、冰島/奧地利/捷克/蒙特內哥羅各 2 起、墨西哥/比利時/瑞典各 1 起。 墨西哥於 2026/5/1 報告 3 起 H7N3 疫情。 秘魯於 2026/5/5 報告 16 起 H5(N untyped)疫情。 冰島於 2026/5/6 報告 2 起 H5N5 疫情。   美國乳牛感染禽流感自 2024 年 3 月迄今累計 20 州報告 1,093 起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/26-5/2 共 465 個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡/印第安納州共 8 個採檢點檢出 H5 陽性。
lvCTwlbbJhjn9_fari351Q.en: Update. Human cases: Bangladesh reported one new H5N1 case and China one new H5N6 case. Globally, 20 cases have been reported this year: six H5N1, one H5N6, 12 H9N2 and one H10N3. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,367 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Twelve countries reported 43 H5N1 outbreaks between 30 April and 8 May 2026: Poland 13, the United States 7, the United Kingdom 6, Denmark and Norway three each, Iceland, Austria, Czechia and Montenegro two each, and Mexico, Belgium and Sweden one each. Mexico reported three H7N3 outbreaks on 1 May 2026. Peru reported 16 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks on 5 May 2026. Iceland reported two H5N5 outbreaks on 6 May 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 465 sampling sites during 26 April–2 May 2026, of which eight sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Oregon and Indiana detected H5-positive results.

PGDZ3t1N7EPJ6bcIWV9SJg.zh: 孟加拉疫情上升,自今年 3/15 迄今累計 4 萬餘例疑病例(5,313 例確診)及近 300 例死亡,過去 24 小時內即報告 1 千餘例疑病例,約 50%病例發生於達卡。該國 2024-2025 年遭遇疫苗及檢測試劑短缺問題,可能造成疫苗接種率下降,進而爆發疫情。
PGDZ3t1N7EPJ6bcIWV9SJg.en: Bangladesh's outbreak is rising. Since 15 March this year, more than 40,000 suspected cases (5,313 confirmed) and nearly 300 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with more than 1,000 suspected cases reported in the past 24 hours alone. About 50% of cases have occurred in Dhaka. Bangladesh experienced shortages of vaccines and testing reagents in 2024–2025, which may have led to a decline in vaccination coverage and subsequent outbreaks.

6f9zc5fknSBFAHZi6pNvuQ.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,今年截至4/22累計報告362例,高於去(2025) 年全年病例數(265 例),分布以東京都(153 例)、神奈川縣(36 例)、鹿兒島縣(34 例)、千葉縣(24 例)及愛知縣(23 例)為多,其中 33 例為境外移入病例,59%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 孟加拉自今年 3/15 疫情爆發,截至 4/17 累計報告逾 3 萬例疑病例(含 4,460 例確診),其中 251 例病例死亡(含 42 例確診),疫情目前已擴及全國,當局目前亦面臨檢測試劑短缺問題。 巴基斯坦今年截至 3 月累計報告 4,541 例確定病例及 71 例兒童死亡病例,其中以北部開伯爾-普什圖省(1,712 例)、中部旁遮普省(1,198 例)及東南部信德省(1,183 例)為多,此次疫情係因該國於COVID-19 流行期間中斷預防接種作業而產生大量未接種疫苗兒童族群所致,當局刻正規劃擴大預防接種作業。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年累計報告 10,065 例確定病例及 72 例死亡病例,死亡病例多發生於交通不便地區,當局已提供免費醫療及疫苗接種服務。
6f9zc5fknSBFAHZi6pNvuQ.en: Japan: the outbreak has risen sharply, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 22 April this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (265 cases). Cases are concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (153), Kanagawa Prefecture (36), Kagoshima Prefecture (34), Chiba Prefecture (24) and Aichi Prefecture (23). Of these, 33 were imported, and 59% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Bangladesh: since the outbreak began on 15 March this year, more than 30,000 suspected cases (including 4,460 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively as of 17 April, of which 251 died (including 42 confirmed). The outbreak has now spread across the country, and authorities face a shortage of testing reagents. Pakistan: as of March this year, 4,541 confirmed cases and 71 child deaths had been reported cumulatively. Cases are concentrated in the northern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (1,712), central Punjab Province (1,198) and south-eastern Sindh Province (1,183). The outbreak is attributed to the large number of unvaccinated children created when immunisation was suspended during the COVID-19 pandemic, and authorities are planning to expand immunisation. DRC: South Kivu Province in eastern DRC has reported 10,065 confirmed cases and 72 deaths cumulatively this year. Most deaths occurred in areas with poor transport access, and authorities have provided free medical care and vaccination services.

QPUfBYtHchWBbjkOkWdwxg.zh: 孟加拉疫情自 2026 年 1 月起急遽升溫,目前已擴及全國 8 行政區共 56 縣。自 3/15 迄今,累計報告逾 1.8 萬例疑病例(含 2,897 例確診),病例集中於人口稠密區與貧民窟群落,並以達卡(Dhaka)近 8千例居多。當局已於 4/5 起針對高風險區幼童展開擴大疫苗接種,預計陸續推廣至全國。WHO 表示多區持續傳播、易感兒童數量龐大、明確之免疫缺口及死亡病例,評估該國傳播風險為高,全球風險為中。
QPUfBYtHchWBbjkOkWdwxg.en: Bangladesh's outbreak has risen sharply since January 2026 and has now spread to eight administrative divisions and 56 districts nationwide. Since 15 March, more than 18,000 suspected cases (including 2,897 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively. Cases are concentrated in densely populated areas and slum communities, with nearly 8,000 in Dhaka. From 5 April, authorities began expanded vaccination of young children in high-risk areas, with plans to roll it out gradually nationwide. WHO states that ongoing transmission in multiple areas, a large number of susceptible children, clear immunity gaps and reported deaths lead it to assess the transmission risk in Bangladesh as high and the global risk as moderate.

RhVhu2gJ9U3TuHoMA7xOKg.zh: 孟加拉北部塔古爾岡縣(Thakurgaon)於 4/18 報告 1 例死亡病例,病患於 3/26 遭狐狸咬傷,後續雖有接種疫苗,惟仍於暴露後 17 天出現大量口水和嘔吐等症狀後死亡。評估因當地擴大玉米種植造成生態改變,近期已發生多起狐狸攻擊人類事件。
RhVhu2gJ9U3TuHoMA7xOKg.en: In Thakurgaon District in northern Bangladesh, one death was reported on 18 April. The patient was bitten by a fox on 26 March and, although vaccinated afterwards, developed heavy salivation and vomiting 17 days after exposure and died. Authorities assess that ecological changes caused by the expansion of maize cultivation in the area have led to several recent fox attacks on humans.

0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.zh: 日本疫情更新,今(2026)年截至4/1累計報告197例,其中28例為境外移入病例,以15-29年齡層為多(占50%),分布以東京都48例、鹿兒島縣24例、愛知縣23例及神奈川縣19例為多。該國去(2025)年報告265例確定病例。 孟加拉疫情上升,該國今年截至3月累計報告722例確定病例,其中僅3月即報告514例,57%病例為6個月以下嬰兒,自3月中旬以來已報告逾7,600例疑病例,近6週報告逾113例死亡,當局已針對30個高風險地區,共計逾130萬名6個月至5歲以下兒童啟動緊急疫苗接種作業。 美洲疫情持續,墨西哥今年截至4/6累計報告8,750例確定病例,其中9例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(5,062例)為多;美國今年截至4/2共33州累計報告1,671例確定病例,猶他州近期疫情上升;加拿大今年截至3/21累計報告650例確定病例,病例數以曼托巴省(392例)及亞伯達省(209例)為多;瓜地馬拉疫情上升,今年截至3/29共計22省累計報告3,594例確定病例,其中54%病例集中於中南部瓜地馬拉省,該國正聖週期間,宗教活動及旅遊增加,預期病例數將持續上升。
0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 1 April this year, 197 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 28 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (48 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (24), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa Prefecture (19) reported the most. Japan reported 265 confirmed cases last year. Bangladesh's outbreak is rising: as of March this year, 722 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 514 were reported in March alone; 57% of cases were infants under 6 months old. Since mid-March, more than 7,600 suspected cases have been reported, and more than 113 deaths were reported over the past six weeks. Authorities have launched emergency vaccination for more than 1.3 million children aged 6 months to under 5 years in 30 high-risk areas. The outbreak in the Americas continues: as of 6 April this year, Mexico has reported 8,750 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 9 deaths, with most cases in western Jalisco State (5,062 cases). As of 2 April this year, the United States has reported 1,671 confirmed cases across 33 states, and the outbreak in Utah has recently risen. As of 21 March this year, Canada has reported 650 confirmed cases, mainly in Manitoba (392 cases) and Alberta (209 cases). Guatemala's outbreak is rising: as of 29 March this year, 3,594 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 departments, with 54% concentrated in Guatemala Department in the central-south. During Holy Week, religious activities and travel increased, and case numbers are expected to continue rising.

9_mbLTnEJLVgHXo79eKv-g.zh: 孟加拉爆發麻疹疫情,今年3月共計7地區報告21例兒童死亡病例,今年累計報告逾46例死亡病例,當局表示疫情從去(2025)年12月開始上升,於3月急遽增加,疫情於全國大部分地區流行,確診病例逾1,500例,惟仍未掌握疫情相關死亡資訊。該國最近一次麻疹疫苗接種活動為2020年,多數兒童未定時接種疫苗,另全國有疫苗短缺問題,當局已進行緊急疫苗採購並籌備專門醫院。
9_mbLTnEJLVgHXo79eKv-g.en: Bangladesh is experiencing a measles outbreak. In March this year, 7 regions reported 21 child deaths, and more than 46 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year. Authorities say the outbreak began rising in December last year, increased sharply in March, and is now circulating in most parts of the country. More than 1,500 confirmed cases have been reported, but information on outbreak-related deaths is still lacking. The country's most recent measles vaccination campaign was in 2020, and most children have not been vaccinated on schedule. The country also faces a vaccine shortage; authorities have carried out emergency vaccine procurement and are preparing a dedicated hospital.

nTW1aCskiCG2kH6vGB3Kjg.zh: WHO於3/6發布全球快速風險評估,疫情具明顯之地理與季節侷限性,主要集中於東南亞與西太平洋區域之自然宿主分布區,雖致死率高(40-75%),惟人傳人有侷限性,且迄未有持續性社區傳播或跨國擴散的跡象,評估全球傳播風險為低。  去(2025)年印度及孟加拉分別報告4例確定病例,今(2026)年截至3/6印度及孟加拉累計報告3例散發確定個案。主要傳播模式為動物源性溢出(Zoonotic Spillover),人際傳播多侷限於醫療照護之院內感染或家戶密切接觸; 非流行地區風險主要為受感染者或受感染牲畜之跨境輸入,惟於非病毒流行地區,次傳播之可能性極低;前往受影響地區旅客風險極低(惟不為零),須留意直接接觸食果蝠、食用受污染食品或接觸豬、馬等受感染動物者; 發生疫情國家已強化其監測系統、診斷及臨床管理能力,目前臨床上尚無核准之疫苗或藥物,快速病例隔離及接觸者追蹤為防止疫情擴散之有效措施; 建議各國應提升對不明原因腦炎的檢測能力,特別是有流行區旅遊史病例;醫療機構應落實標準防護措施,預防院內感染。WHO 空氣或飛沫傳染病疫情
nTW1aCskiCG2kH6vGB3Kjg.en: On 6 March, WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment. The outbreaks have clear geographic and seasonal limitations and are mainly concentrated in the areas of natural host distribution in Southeast Asia and the Western Pacific. Although the case fatality rate is high (40–75%), human-to-human transmission is limited, and there have been no signs of sustained community transmission or cross-border spread to date. WHO assesses the global transmission risk as low. In 2025, India and Bangladesh each reported 4 confirmed cases, and as of 6 March this year they have cumulatively reported 3 sporadic confirmed cases. The main transmission pattern is zoonotic spillover; human transmission is mostly limited to nosocomial infection in healthcare settings or close household contact. The risk in non-endemic areas is mainly cross-border importation of infected people or infected livestock, and secondary transmission in non-endemic areas is extremely unlikely. The risk to travellers to affected areas is very low (though not zero); attention should be paid to direct contact with fruit bats, consumption of contaminated food, or contact with infected animals such as pigs and horses. Countries with outbreaks have strengthened their surveillance systems and diagnostic and clinical management capacity. There are currently no licensed vaccines or drugs for clinical use; rapid case isolation and contact tracing are effective measures to prevent spread. WHO recommends that countries improve testing capacity for unexplained encephalitis, particularly in cases with a history of travel to endemic areas, and that healthcare facilities implement standard precautions to prevent nosocomial infection. WHO. Airborne or droplet-transmitted disease outbreak.

vInp9-Ugnml9tNI_w0Lu_w.zh: 孟加拉研究發現新興蝙蝠來源病毒,5名2022年12月至2023 年3疑感染立百病毒病例(NiV),經PCR 與血清檢測皆為NiV陰性,其中3例成功培養出病毒,且透過高通量定序確認狐蝠正呼腸孤病毒(Pteropine orthoreovirus, PRV),病患皆曾食用生棗椰汁,病例間無流行病學關聯,病患臨床症狀包含發燒、意識混亂、行走異常、呼吸困難及腦炎,其中1名病患於2024年因不明神經症狀惡化死亡,研究顯示食用生椰棗汁的疾病風險不僅限於NiV感染,另PRV病毒基因重組潛力可能致其傳播性和毒力的改變,研究建議於食用生椰棗汁地區,應進行分子和血清學監測,並針對腦炎及其他不明原因發燒疾病之呼吸道疾病進行PRV、NiV及其他蝙蝠傳播病毒鑑別診斷。
vInp9-Ugnml9tNI_w0Lu_w.en: A study in Bangladesh identified an emerging bat-borne virus. Five people suspected of Nipah virus (NiV) infection between December 2022 and March 2023 tested negative for NiV by PCR and serological testing. Three of the samples yielded virus isolates, and high-throughput sequencing confirmed Pteropine orthoreovirus (PRV). All patients had consumed raw date palm sap, and the cases had no epidemiological link to one another. Clinical symptoms included fever, confusion, gait abnormalities, difficulty breathing and encephalitis. One patient died in 2024 after unexplained neurological symptoms worsened. The study found that the disease risk from consuming raw date palm sap is not limited to NiV infection. Genetic reassortment of PRV may alter its transmissibility and virulence. The study recommends molecular and serological surveillance in areas where raw date palm sap is consumed, and differential diagnosis for PRV, NiV and other bat-borne viruses in patients with encephalitis or febrile respiratory illness of unknown cause.

merfEYWK1Nnvtdpj6TuRLg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第42週(10/13-19)全球陽性率10.88%,其中,歐洲及東地中海區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第43週定醫平均報告數2.25,已連續6週下降,分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第42週陽性率12.19%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,孟加拉、印度、泰國及泊爾等國第42週陽性率皆處低點。 澳洲疫情處低點,第41週定點實驗室監測陽性率降至1.2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(52.3%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈波動下降趨勢,其中,東南亞、歐洲及東地中海區呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占81%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占12%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。

Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 42 was 12.19%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point; positivity rates in week 42 were at low levels in Bangladesh, India, Thailand and Nepal. Australia: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate in sentinel laboratory surveillance fell to 1.2% in week 41, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share (52.3%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown a fluctuating downward trend, but Southeast Asia, Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean regions are rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (81%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

HxnLVn7rQwHF4-t0vLGcjA.en: Bangladesh has reported four deaths cumulatively this year as of 29 August (three of which were previously known), in different areas. The first three cases were confirmed in January and February this year and comprised two adult men and one adult woman, with onset between 25 January and 17 February. All three died after hospitalization. Investigation found that all of these patients had drunk raw date palm sap, and all their contacts tested negative. Case 4 was a boy who developed symptoms on 6 August, was hospitalized and transferred to the intensive care unit on 8–9 August, and died on 14 August. A total of 72 contacts were identified; 11 contacts with symptoms were sampled, 6 of whom tested negative, and the remaining tests are pending. Since 2001, the country has cumulatively reported 347 cases, of which 249 were fatal (CFR: 72%). Apart from 2023, case numbers in the past 10 years have been below 10. WHO assesses the risk to the country and region as moderate, and the global risk as low.

MgNUiDzu6fL_8pnDiKLHLw.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: one new human H5 influenza infection was reported in Bangladesh this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of nine countries reported 26 H5N1 outbreaks during 1–5 September 2025, including South Africa and Norway (6 each), Germany and the Netherlands (3 each), Taiwan, the UK and Spain (2 each), and Portugal and Argentina (1 each). Norway reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 1–4 September 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,079 (1) herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 35, 431 sampling sites provided results; three sampling sites in one state (California) detected H5-positive samples. Other updates: the US FDA announced that a brand of raw cat food was contaminated with H5N1 influenza virus. The San Francisco Department of Public Health was notified that a domestic cat had been infected with H5N1 after eating that brand and was euthanized. Authorities tested the product and found it H5N1-positive. The FDA then tested the product and the dead cat, and found they shared a common source; both were genotype B3.13. No human infections from contact with the contaminated pet food have been identified so far. Annual summary. Human cases: this year, one H5 (including presumptive) influenza case, 27 H5N1 influenza cases (990 cumulatively since 2003), 18 H9N2 influenza cases (146 cumulatively) and two H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 58 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,242 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

diSFX6Cg4zSRe5XKFKv5rw.en: Global influenza activity is at a low level, with influenza A the main circulating type. The Northern Hemisphere as a whole remains low and stable. Most countries in the Southern Hemisphere remain stable, but test positivity in South-East Asia and Oceania is slightly higher (10%). By subtype, H1N1 predominates in Central America, West Africa and Oceania; H3N2 predominates in South Asia and South-East Asia; in East Africa, influenza A and B detections are similar in proportion.

WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.
